optimizedCv.targetRoleTitle: Technical Project Manager, Wealth Services Platform

professionalSummary.text: Technical Project Manager with 18 months of end-to-end ownership of a reporting-engine migration project for a private bank's wealth services platform, directly accountable for cohort go-live decisions and steering committee updates.
professionalSummary.witness: Responsibilities included plan and risk-log maintenance, steering pack preparation, readiness coordination and go-live notes for the migration project over about eighteen months, working to the programme director.

experienceHighlights.text: Maintained project plan, risk log, and adviser-cohort schedule in project tool, re-planning schedule after 3-week data-migration delay.
experienceHighlights.witness: Maintained the project plan, the risk log and the adviser-cohort schedule for the reporting-engine migration in the project tool, re-planning the schedule when the data-migration phase slipped by three weeks.

experienceHighlights.text: Prepared and presented steering committee updates monthly, including schedule and risk sections, with go-live decisions made by programme director based on candidate's recommendations.
experienceHighlights.witness: Prepared the steering committee pack each month and presented the schedule and risk sections; the programme director chaired the committee and put the cohort go-live decisions to it.

experienceHighlights.text: Coordinated cohort readiness with adviser operations and platform team using readiness checklist, with go-live approved by steering committee on programme director's recommendation.
experienceHighlights.witness: Coordinated cohort readiness with adviser operations and the platform team through the readiness checklist; each cohort's go-live was approved by the steering committee on the programme director's recommendation.

experienceHighlights.text: Documented go-live notes for four adviser cohorts, detailing open defects, reporting limitations during parallel run, and hand-over items for adviser support.
experienceHighlights.witness: Wrote the go-live note for each of the four adviser cohorts, listing open defects, reporting limitations during the parallel run and the hand-over items for adviser support.

projectsAndWorkSamples.text: Cohort schedule export with readiness checklist for cohort three and steering committee pack for one month, with project tool record identifiers as verification trail.
projectsAndWorkSamples.witness: Work sample: the cohort schedule export with the readiness checklist for cohort three and the steering committee pack for one month, with the project tool's record identifiers as a verification trail.

skills.text: End-to-end project ownership, risk management, stakeholder coordination, and documentation for complex migration projects.
skills.witness: Responsibilities included plan and risk-log maintenance, steering pack preparation, readiness coordination and go-live notes for the migration project over about eighteen months, working to the programme director.

optimizedCv.evidenceBoundary: The materials establish the candidate's direct involvement in maintaining project tools, preparing steering committee updates, coordinating readiness, and documenting go-live notes. They do not establish the candidate personally held go-live decisions (as the programme director made those decisions) or managed the project budget.

decisionBoundary.statement: Human review required due to unverified claims about holding go-live decisions and budget ownership.
